notes:
Summary: Large fintech risk platform evaluating Redwood Dedicated for low-latency chat + reranking pipelines. Primary negotiation is around throughput guarantees and burst policy for month-end spikes. Wants concrete min sustained tokens/sec, concurrency caps per model, and a defined burst envelope with automated grace credits.

Key ask (from CTO): 'We need guaranteed baseline throughput for model scoring during market-open spikes — can't be best-effort.' Wants ability to reserve capacity across two regions for failover.

Throughput negotiation targets (customer stated):
- Sustained baseline: 2,000 tokens/sec sustained per reserved pool (org-level SLA)
- Concurrency: soft cap 64 simultaneous sessions; hard cap negotiable but prefer 128 for headroom
- Burst policy: allow short bursts up to 20,000 tokens/sec for up to 5 minutes with automatic throttling after burst window; prefer automated burst tokens tied to committed baseline
- Precedence: prefer dedicated reserved GPUs (no preemptible) with pinned model versions and KV cache warmup guarantees

Latency SLOs discussed:
- P95 token-latency target: <= 180ms for typical 2k prompt length (1k context + 1k generation) in NA region
- P99 target: <= 400ms for same workload; customer asks for escalation path if p99 breaches 3x SLA in a week

Reserved GPU planning notes:
- Initial ask: reserve 8 x A100-class GPUs (or equivalent) distributed 6 NA / 2 EU for residency/failover
- Autoscale: allow burst pool to spin up additional 4 GPUs for up to 24h in emergencies, billing prorated
- Warmup: SE must provide KV cache prewarming plan and cold-start latency profile for acceptance

Acceptance testing / perf run (requirements):
- Redwood to run 3-run perf fixture, customer to provide synthetic traces (real distribution)
- Success criteria: sustained tokens/sec >= baseline with p95/p99 within SLO across 3/3 runs; otherwise remediation plan + SLA credits applied

Commercial / SLA negotiation points:
- Credit schedule tied to % time below min tokens/sec and p95/p99 breach windows
- Requesting uptime SLA 99.95% for committed pool (with carve-outs for customer network issues)
- Want monthly usage caps and rollover of unused burst tokens for first 3 months
